acceptanceCriteria: The iPhone automatically transfers a complete versioned replica of required profiles, tuning systems, tunings, reference configurations, visibility/replacement state, and stable identities to the paired Watch without granting the Watch authoring authority.

The Watch stages each candidate separately; it activates only a complete, schema-compatible candidate whose manifest, stable identities, references, ordering, limits, and playable dependencies validate successfully.
Interrupted, incomplete, malformed, invalid, and unsupported-newer candidates cannot displace or partially mix with the last valid compatible Watch replica; the prior replica remains usable.

The Watch operates from valid local data while the iPhone is unreachable, and its status accurately distinguishes valid data, pending synchronization, last successful update, and actionable failure or incompatibility.

Deletion, visibility change, and replacement propagate safely. If selected Watch data disappears, local playback stops, a valid fallback is selected silently, and playback requires an explicit new action.

Synchronization is isolated from iPhone playback, editing, launch, and local persistence; it adds no cloud database, application network traffic, account, remote playback control, or Watch profile authoring.
notes: Detailed protocol, state, scope, and evidence boundaries: docs/Sprints/SP-012-Planning.md.
The Watch is a locally playable replica, never the sole recovery authority. A failed or incompatible candidate preserves the last valid compatible replica.
No cloud service, application network traffic, remote playback control, or Watch profile authoring. Physical-device Watch qualification belongs to SP-013.

Implementation evidence: DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode-beta.app/Contents/Developer swift test --package-path Packages/JustTonesCore passed 38 tests, including WatchReplicaTests; xcodebuild -project JustTones.xcodeproj -scheme JustTones -sdk iphonesimulator -destination generic/platform=iOS Simulator CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build succeeded with temporary DerivedData.
Paired WatchConnectivity transfer, disconnected behavior, and physical-device route/wrist-down qualification remain unverified.
rationale: The Watch is a playback replica and must never activate partial data, corrupt valid local data, create unexpected audio, or delay primary iPhone operation.
testSteps: Run JT-TEST-080 and JT-TEST-081 for automatic transfer and iPhone-only administration.
Run JT-TEST-082 and JT-TEST-083 for cross-device identity, complete validation, interrupted transfer, and atomic activation.
Run JT-TEST-084 through JT-TEST-087 for disconnected operation, truthful status, deletion/replacement fallback, and compatibility retention.
Run JT-TEST-167 to demonstrate that recovery remains iPhone-authoritative and the Watch replica is not a backup.

Add focused deterministic tests for candidate validation, atomic replacement, failure containment, and synchronization isolation; record actual beta-toolchain commands and outcomes. Keep simulator/model evidence separate from SP-013 physical-device qualification.
